items.title: Banshee Login Reward Starting September 23!
items.summary: The September 23 release of Iceblade of Narin gives Banshee fans three huge reasons to perk up their ears. If you've enjoyed playing with her in the past, or want to wield her sound-based Abilities for the first time, you definitely don't w
items.content:
The September 23 release of Iceblade of Narin gives Banshee fans three huge reasons to perk up their ears. If you've enjoyed playing with her in the past, or want to wield her sound-based Abilities for the first time, you definitely don't want to sleep through our next update.

FREE Login Reward

Log in any time between September 23 and October 7 and you'll receive a FREE base Banshee Warframe, which means you can experience these highly-anticipated enhancements for yourself, regardless of Mastery Rank or experience level. We'll even include a free, built Forma for extra freedom when testing her new and improved Abilities. Want to invite a new friend to join you in the Origin System? Use your unique code and nab extra Rewards for both of you – your friend will get to enjoy a free Banshee, as well! For more details on our Iceblade of Narin update, visit our official website here.

Banshee Rework

The sonic Warframe has long been known for her capacity to vastly increase the damage of virtually any weapon you might add to your Loadout. And now, she can crank up the volume easier than ever before. With improved synergies across her kit, increased survivability and an overall QoL bump, she's now more Tenno-friendly and fun to use whatever your level of experience. For more information, watch the full Dev Workshop:

Banshee Threnodia

Lament the spirits of the dead with the baleful Banshee Threnodia Skin and corresponding Collection of mournful Customizations. The stark visage of this gorgeous apparition brings a gothically gaunt aesthetic to the scream queen – a sensuous feast for the eyes and ears.

items.title: ‘Warframe’ & ‘Soulframe’ Updates Arriving This Fall
items.summary: Live from South Korea from their TennoVIP Community Event, developer Digital Extremes talked up a storm about their coming 'Warframe' and 'Soulframe'
items.content:
Mobile News Nintendo PC PlayStation Xbox Genghis Husameddin

Live from South Korea from their TennoVIP Community Event, developer Digital Extremes talked up a storm about their coming ‘Warframe’ and ‘Soulframe’ updates scheduled for this Fall. Warframe’s next major update, “Iceblade of Narin”, is set to arrive free on all platforms 23 September, with new details showcased for the 66th Warframe, Narin, alongside a first-look at new six-player squad missions, a new relay hub and enemy variant, Citrine Prime Access, and a once-in-a-lifetime in-game community event – Epoch Operation: Taubound (launching 15 October) – for players to prepare for the arrival of Warframe: Tau later this year. Additionally, the game will be launching on the Samsung Galaxy storefront very soon. Soulframe players tuning in were treated to new details around Preludes 16, a free update arriving mid-September that introduces wolf cub bonding, fishing, and dynamic weather changes among other slick new additions.

Return to the Zariman shipwreck and uncover the lost secret of Narin, the 66th Warframe, in the Iceblade of Narin update, arriving free all platforms September 23:

Warframe is extending its capsule collection collaboration with fashion house ARK/8 to offer fans around the world an opportunity to secure slick new apparel inspired by Jade Shadows: Constellations and other aspects of Warframe . Available online at warframe.ark8.net and at ARK/8’s physical retail location in Los Angeles on September 9, the capsule collection offers apparel featuring Garuda, Ash, Loki, Mag, Rhino, and of course, Excalibur.

Warframe is available across PC via Warframe.com /Steam (Windows & Linux via Proton), Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch consoles, iOS, and Android devices. Full cross-save and crossplay are supported across all platforms. Soulframe is available in Early Access form on PC via Soulframe.com, currently for paid pack members.

items.content:
Warframe promo codes unlock various boosts and cosmetic rewards, so this is how to claim them in-game or online

(Image credit: Digital Extremes) Jump To: Warframe codes How to redeem Warframe Creator Glyph codes {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Warframe codes can be used to access a wide range of cosmetics, which will let you customize the look of your profile, ship, and more in this perennial free-to-play shooter. There are also promos that will provide you with a booster for a set number of days, speeding up your progress when levelling up your Tenno. There are a couple of different ways to add these rewards to your account, so to explain it all, here are the current Warframe promo codes and how to redeem them in-game or online.

The following Warframe promo codes can be claimed for rewards:

There are currently a decent number of active Warframe codes available, which generally unlock cosmetic items such as glyphs or decorations to customize your profile and ship with, though some will also provide boosts to speed up your progress for a certain amount of time. Additionally there are a huge number of Warframe promo codes that unlock various creator glyphs, which we've listed further down as there's so many of them!

There are two routes to redeem Warframe promo codes, with the first being via the in-game Market screen. This can be accessed from the pause menu or by interacting with the terminal on your ship, then once there follow the REDEEM CODE prompt for your platform in the bottom right corner of the screen before entering the promo in the text box that appears. These codes are not case-sensitive, so you don't need to worry about capitalization as long as the correct spelling is used.

The other method to redeem promo codes in Warframe is to visit the official Redeem Code website , where you'll need to log in to your account if you haven't done so already. Then you can simply type or copy and paste each code into the Promo Code text box, before hitting the SUBMIT CODE button to claim your reward, which will then be delivered to you in-game.

In addition to the general codes listed above, there are also a huge number of promos that can be used to unlock glyphs relating to various creators:

There are plenty of expired Warframe codes, which isn't a surprise given how many years the game has now been available for. The turnover for most of the promos is fairly short, so make sure you've been through the currently active codes and picked up all of the rewards there.

items.title: Warframe of Mind: Reacting to everything unveiled in the Iceblade of Narin preview
Digital Extremes Showcases New Warframe Updates Arriving Fall 2026 in Special Devstream Live
items.content:
0 Digital Extremes thawed out plenty of upcoming treats arriving this fall for Warframe in a special edition Devstream live from its TennoVIP community event in Seoul, South Korea. Warframe’s next major update, Iceblade of Narin, is set to arrive free on all platforms September 23, with new details showcased for the 66th Warframe, Narin, alongside a first-look at new six-player squad missions, a new relay hub and enemy variant, Citrine Prime Access, and a once-in-a-lifetime in-game community event – Epoch Operation: Taubound (launching October 15) – for players to prepare for the arrival of Warframe: Tau later this year.

“We are continuing our little world tour and are so excited to be amongst fellow Tenno, for the very first time, in South Korea today,” said Megan Everett, Director of Community at Digital Extremes. “Community is paramount to everything we do, and every choice we make serves the greater purpose of continuing to build trust with this global audience of players who have helped us keep the lights on for nearly 14 years. The year is just heating up for Warframe and we’ve got tons of fun surprises to delight players with as we venture toward a new destination later this year in Warframe: Tau. We’re going to need the community’s help to get us there!”

Return to the Zariman shipwreck and uncover the lost secret of Narin, the 66th Warframe, in the Iceblade of Narin update, arriving free all platforms September 23:

Seek out the forgotten history of Narin and master the art of sword and ice to discover a unique ability kit that brings a new meaning to crowd control with Warframe’s first female ice frame.

Wield Narin’s signature Nunchasa bow, and dual ice pistols Aksondol to unleash a hail of cold with precision and fluidity.

Discover new missions, locations, enemies, resources and rewards:

Narin’s Crest has materialized on the Yuvan Peak – creating the newest Relay Hub within the Origin System. When a player goes to select the node, the Earth will rotate, revealing a previously hidden side of Earth.

Iceblade of Narin introduces a brand-new 6-player squad gameplay mode: Glacial Defiance. 6-player missions are played on existing mission levels with new and challenging twists for players to uncover. On completion, players are transported to a new area - Melica’s Labroom - to discover their earned rewards.

Upon opening Melica’s Labroom, new Entropic Eximus enemies will spawn in throughout Zariman missions - these adversaries drop Entropic Kuva that can be traded with Cephalon Melica for new update-themed wares.

Heed the call of Tau’s beckoning and prepare for Epoch Operation: Taubound, a once-in-a-lifetime in-game community event arriving October 15:

A heavy unit is approaching. Following the release of the Iceblade of Narin Update, prepare for the next Narrative Chapter of Warframe arriving later this year, Warframe: Tau. Epoch Operation: Taubound is a massive time-limited in-game event designed to unite Warframe’s global community to build the path to Tau together.

Complete The Hex and The Old Peace to gain access to the mini-Quest, Prologue to Tau, continuing the events of The Old Peace and revealing lost memories of the Lotus.

Jumping into the world of Warframe for the first time? After completing the Vor’s Prize introductory Quest, head to Eris and join the community in collecting a new resource, Moonflesh, to convert into the necessary fuel required to get to the ever-distant Tau Star System. Players who have not met Prologue to Tau mini-Quest requirements can still earn event-exclusive rewards!

Polish off the Foundry for the prismatic arrival of Citrine Prime Access, arriving alongside the Iceblade of Narin update September 23:

items.title: Warframe Devstream 197 Breakdown
items.summary: Devstream 197 for Warframe featured a ton of content for players to enjoy over the next few months, here is everything we saw during the stream!
items.content:
Rise and shine, Tenno! Digital Extremes recently wrapped up their live Devstream from Seoul, South Korea. This devstream focused on a wealth of new content coming to Warframe, with some Soulframe content shown as well. In this devstream, we learned pretty much everything there is to know about the upcoming update, Iceblade of Narin , including an event that will bridge the gap to Tau at the end of the year. Here is everything we learned from Devstream 197!

They started the Devstream with the news that Warframe will be launching on the Samsung Galaxy Store on Android devices on September 23rd. Anyone who plays it there at launch will be given a new free color palette and an ephemera.

Members of the Soulframe team, including the Creative Director himself, were present during the stream to talk about the next major update for the preludes pre-alpha program. This update will include:

This update will be called “Of Hook and Hound” and will be launching later in the month. From here, they focused on content coming to Warframe over the next few months (no, really!)

The first bit of content shown was “Epoch Operation: Taubound”. This operation will take players to a new hub on Praghasa from The New War in preparation for going to Tau. The event will launch on October 15th and will feature gameplay for the Vessels, the giant white golems from Whispers in the Walls .

While the event will start on October 15th, there will be a prologue quest that will stay in-game permanently. Players participating in the event will need to “feed” Praghasa with other players. More details on the event will be shared at a later date.

This update will be coming shortly after Iceblade of Narin , which will be arriving in just a few short weeks. Here is everything it will include!

Iceblade of Narin will feature a new player hub at the Yuvan Peak from The War Within. This area is now covered in Zariman posters, and icy swaths around the cliffside. Yuvan Peak will now have a pedastal for Cephalon Malica from the Zariman. She will act as the new vendor for the new game modes coming in this update. The main game mode that will give you the currency for Narin, and her weapons was not talked about. But they did go over a new 6-player activity coming to Warframe.

Glacial Defiance will allow 6 players to take on challenging activities deep within the depths of the Zariman. They did not go over what all entails in the activity, but you can play it 3 times a week for chances at unique loot from it. The main activity that will be tied to earning Narin and her weapons will feature a new eximus unit they did not show off that will drop a special resource to buy her from Malica. Speaking of Narin and her weapons, however…

During the Devstream, they showed off a stunning trailer that featured Narin and all of her glory. For fans of Limbo, she will be a new top hat wearing frame with a special rapier and area-of-effect abilities.

In the Devstream they went into thorough detail on Narin and how she will work. Below will be a small breakdown of her abilities, as outlined by Pablo Alonso during the Devstream:

Her signature weapons will be a bow and pair of akimbo pistols. The bow, Nunchasa, will have an alternate fire that fires out a charged arrow that leaves behind an icy trail. With the pistols, Aksondol, creating a frosty area around the player when they reload. They also showed off the banshee rework, along with Citrine prime and the new deluxe skins coming in the update.

In Iceblade of Narin, Banshee will be getting a new rework. This rework is not massive, but will make her more viable in Warframe overall:

For the first 2 weeks of the update, Banshee will be given out for free with a free forma as well. Below will be Pablo’s breakdown of it during the Devstream!

items.title: What is the release date of Iceblade of Narin in Warframe?
items.content:
Guide What is the release date of Iceblade of Narin in Warframe? A cold front is coming.

Since the very earliest days of Warframe, there has been a single Frame who commanded ice and cold. That is all about to change, as the upcoming Iceblade of Narin finally has a confirmed release date and will introduce a brand-new ice-focused Warframe to add to our collections.

The Iceblade of Narin will release on September 23, arriving as a free update, just like all Warframe content drops. The update will introduce Narin, only the second Warframe in the game's history to use ice powers, and it seems as though she has some kind of awesome ice sword as well.

There are some very cool touches being added in this update, as the Yuvan Peak node on Earth will act as a Relay and will also cause the Earth to rotate, giving us our first look at the far side of the planet. We will be getting a new six-player squad mode called Glacial Defense. After this new mode, you will be transported to a new area called Melica's Labroom to get your rewards.

Citrine Prime will be added to the game, along with a Deluxe Banshee skin and a Banshee rework to make her kit more relevant to the modern game. Personally, I enjoy bringing Banshee into Void Cascade, so I am eager to see how improved her build options will be for tough endgame activities.

items.title: Iceblade of Narin arrives September 23!
items.summary: Return to the Zariman and master a new Warframe as deadly as a winter blizzard when Iceblade of Narin launches on all platforms September 23! Log in between Sept. 23 and Oct. 7 to also receive a free Banshee Warframe as a login reward. Watc
items.content:
Return to the Zariman and master a new Warframe as deadly as a winter blizzard when Iceblade of Narin launches on all platforms September 23! Log in between Sept. 23 and Oct. 7 to also receive a free Banshee Warframe as a login reward. Watch the Iceblade of Narin Gameplay Trailer, featuring voiceover from Choi Han:

Narin, Sword Dancer Warframe

Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes. See more of Narin's Abilities in action:

Entropic Eximus

New Eximus enemies stalk the halls of the Zariman. Your Operator can chip away at their health, but your best option is to enhance your Melee Damage at the Yuvan Peak. Entropic Eximus enemies may drop Entropic Kuva, which you can use to trade with Cephalon Melica for rewards like Blueprints to craft Narin!

Yuvan Peak

Visit the dark side of Earth and enter a brand-new social Relay! At this spectacular mountain summit, you'll find Narin's Crest – and the Duelist Warframe's legendary sword encased firmly in the ice. Who will be the first to remove Narin's Iceblade?

Melica's Lab

A previously-unknown area has been discovered aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, prompting the appearance of resilient new Entropic Eximus enemies. Help Cephalon Melica defeat them to sever a dormant (but growing) connection to the Man in the Wall.

Riven System Changes

With the launch of Iceblade of Narin, you will be able to preserve specific Riven traits during rerolls using Kuva! We've also introduced Riven Splicers which can be utilized via the Mod Segment in your Orbiter and allow you to combine two Riven traits into a new one from a special pool of possibilities.

TennoGen Iceblade

The latest Customizations borne from the Warframe community include unique new fashions inspired by Necramechs and the Grineer Worm Queen. There's also a flowery new helmet for Citrine, just in time for her turn in Prime Access! -- But that's not all Tenno! Explore everything coming with Iceblade of Narin on September 23, including Citrine Prime Access, new Customizations for Banshee and Qorvex, and much more: warframe.com

items.title: Epoch Operation: Taubound
items.summary: Arturos and Zioa have lain dormant long enough: the time to assume control of your Vessel is almost at hand. With new worlds and possibilities beyond the Origin System closer than ever, your window to prepare for the journey to Tau begins n
items.content:
Arturos and Zioa have lain dormant long enough: the time to assume control of your Vessel is almost at hand. With new worlds and possibilities beyond the Origin System closer than ever, your window to prepare for the journey to Tau begins now, ahead of a never-before-seen, once in a lifetime Epoch Operation this October.

WHAT IS THE OPERATION?

Epoch Operation: Taubound will open a path to the Tau System with help from the Sentient Mothership, Praghasa. Facilitating your travels will require an extraordinary amount of energy on her part, so you will need to collect fuel to provide the strength she needs. Playing as your Warframe, you will need to visit Mission nodes across Eris to collect Moonflesh for Praghasa. In exchange for this viscous resource, she will offer a number of event-exclusive Rewards, as well as daily login messages for the duration of the Operation. This event calls for the collective participation of Tenno from across the entire community.

WHEN IS IT?

Epoch Operation: Taubound begins October 15 and will run for one month only, concluding on November 17.

HOW DO I PARTICIPATE?

Completing any Mission on Eris will provide Moonflesh, which can be traded to Praghasa for unique, event-exclusive Rewards. Users who interact with Praghasa will also get special, daily narrative updates that will not be repeated in-game after this event ends. Note: All Tenno who have completed Vor's Prize will be able to access Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound. The normal Star Chart and Junction requirements will be lifted for this event.

WHAT IF I MISS IT?

There will be no reruns of Epoch Operation: Taubound. This is a unique and one-time-only event. You will not be able to visit Praghasa for her Epoch Operation dialogue or Rewards again once it is concluded.

WHAT ABOUT MY VESSEL?

Separate from Epoch Operation: Taubound, you will also find a new Tau Prologue Quest added to your Codex starting on October 15. This Quest is a permanent new addition to the Warframe Codex that will remain in place even after Epoch Operation: Taubound ends and can be completed at your leisure. While it is narratively connected to the limited-time event, it is not related to the limited-time Rewards or dialogue found in this Epoch Operation. Note: You must complete The Hex and The Old Peace Quests to access the Tau Prologue Quest. This is not required to harvest Moonflesh as part of Epoch Operation: Taubound. If you would like to complete these Quests before Epoch Operation: Taubound, there's still time! Head over to our official Warframe Quest Guide for help navigating your way through Quest order. --

BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY

items.title: Banshee Prime and Mirage Prime enter Prime Resurgence
items.summary: Acoustic authority or dazzling deceit — which will you choose, Tenno? Prime Resurgence grants access to two of the Origin System’s most powerful Warframes. Banshee Prime If there ever was a siren song to herald the end, it would undoubtedly
items.content:
Acoustic authority or dazzling deceit — which will you choose, Tenno? Prime Resurgence grants access to two of the Origin System’s most powerful Warframes.

Banshee Prime

If there ever was a siren song to herald the end, it would undoubtedly emanate from Banshee Prime. Control the battlefield with her extraordinary ultrasonic abilities that can pinpoint an enemy’s position and exploit their various weaknesses through even the faintest vibration. If you’re all about silencing a crowd, then Banshee Prime might just be the Warframe for you.

Mirage Prime

Deception is an art, and Mirage Prime is a preeminent scholar on the matter. Master manipulation through her utterly mystifying stagecraft, harnessing photokinetic powers that create mirror images and ensnare enemies in lethal traps. There’s no question that Mirage Prime is ideal for anyone that loves to put on a show.

items.content:
Operation: Plague Star descends on the Plains of Eidolon once more from September 9 to September 23, across all platforms. Steal toxin from Councilor Vay Hek and the Grineer, destroy the boil and save Cetus before the Infestation can grow out of control.

What You Need To Do

Speak to Konzu in Cetus to undertake the Plague Star Bounty Complete the series of Bounty Missions to earn Operational Supply Standing for the Event Rewards

What You Need To Know

Bounties come with various requirements for completion that yield specific Rewards outlined below.

Tier 1:

Requirements: No prerequisites Rewards: Base Standing: 1,025 Bounty Bonus Completion: 25 bonus

Tier 2:

Requirements: 1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst Rewards: Base Standing: 3200 Bounty Bonus Completion: 75 bonus

Tier 3:

Requirements:1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst + Steel Path Eligibility Rewards: Base Standing: 3800 Bounty Bonus Completion: 100 bonus In thanks for your hard work, Nakak has some new Offerings pulled from elsewhere in the Origin System for you to claim:
  • Teralyst Prominence Sigil
  • Ostron Community Sigil
  • Rift Sigil
  • Two-Handed Nikana Maligna Skin
  • Umbra Forma (Built)

items.content: Sometimes, the best knowledge you can impart on others is to embrace their softer side — even Teshin is doing it! items.content:
We’re back and sat from across the world! LIVE from Seoul South Korea it’s Devstream #197!!

Soulframe Creative Director, Geoff Crookes, Soulframe Associate Art Director, Rosa Lee, Warframe Creative Director, Rebecca Ford, and Community Director & Live Ops, Megan Everett, and South Korean Host, Will Chobra, are bringing you the first full reveal of our next major update: The Iceblade of Narin! 

Join us as we dive into the sEoul of Iceblade with the first reveal of our 66th Warframe, Narin, from her full ability kit to her deeper connection to a certain Cephalon. Plus all the details on Banshee’s Rework, a showcase of Qorvex Deluxe, Banshee Deluxe, and Citrine Prime. See our next batch of new Community made TennoGen, more about the upcoming Riven Changes, and much more!

Due to the offsite nature of this Devstream, there will be no Twitch Drops. To circumvent this, we have added the Twitch Drop item as an additional Gift of the Lotus alert in-game that will go live when the Devstream concludes. Tune in for the details!
